name: DreamPrompting
description: DreamPrompting routes through shared upstream free tiers with a rolling daily quota.
overview: DreamPrompting offers a no-card OpenAI-compatible gateway backed by pooled upstream free tiers. Each account has 500,000 input plus output tokens and 5,000 requests per rolling 24 hours, plus a 100 request/minute per-IP burst limit. Google sign-in is required for an API key. Capacity is shared and the service may fall back to a different model; set allow_fallback to false if model identity matters.
free_access: 500K tokens and 5,000 requests per rolling 24 hours
No card; Google sign-in for an API key
notes: Use the provider's full route IDs, such as groq/openai/gpt-oss-120b. Shared upstreams can be exhausted; no SLA. Requests are forwarded to third parties and automatic fallback can substitute models.
